SUGGESTIONS

Suggestions for review and selection

Proposals for improving the project, presented so they can be reviewed and selected before any of them are implemented.

How suggestions are handled

A suggestion is a proposal, not a change. Nothing on this list has been implemented. Each entry states the problem it addresses, what the proposal actually is, its impact and effort, and which workstream it unblocks, so a proposal can be selected or rejected on its merits before any code is written. The Unblocks column links suggestions back to the questions and strategies that are waiting on them.

SG-01Archive every weekly injury reportDataThe site currently holds only the current week's report, so no season-long history of designation changes can be analysed.Store a dated snapshot of each weekly report on every refresh, and publish a designation-transition table (practice status to game status) computed from the archive.HighLowQ-09, S2, C3Proposedsource ↗
SG-02Build the timestamped decision logValidationNo strategy can clear the closing-line-value or leakage gates without a decision log that records the price and the as-of time of every input.Add a decision-log writer that stores, for every candidate: the model probability, the quoted price and its timestamp, the inputs with their as-of timestamps, and the settled outcome.HighMediumG5, G9, all strategy evaluationProposedsource ↗
SG-03Aggregate the official penalty log by crewStrategyStrategy S4 depends on crew-level penalty and scoring profiles that are not yet computed.Parse the penalty log from every collected game book, group by referee crew, and publish per-crew penalty rates with sample sizes.MediumMediumS4Proposedsource ↗
SG-04Extend game-book coverage to every completed gameDataDepth charts and box-score measures are only as good as the number of official game books collected.Extend the collector to every completed game of the season, storing the game-book PDF reference and the parsed record for each.HighMediumAll correlation measures, S1-S5, C1-C4Proposedsource ↗
SG-05Add tracking-derived participation dataStrategySnap counts and route data would materially sharpen the depth model, but they are not published as a downloadable table.Add a collector for the Next Gen Stats participation and route endpoints, if a machine-readable interface can be identified.MediumHighRefinement of S1, S2, C3Proposedsource ↗
SG-06Publish per-game correlation sub-matricesAnalysisA single correlation value per pair can hide regime changes; parlay pricing needs the stability of the estimate.Recompute each correlation on rolling windows and publish the series, so a strategy can refuse to trade when the estimate is unstable.MediumLowP1, P2, C1Proposedsource ↗
SG-07Add a player-prop availability tableAvailabilityProp strategies need the availability of the specific player, which the league-wide injury report provides only as a designation.Publish a per-player availability view that joins the injury designation to the depth chart and to the last measured production, with every value carrying its own source link.HighLowC1, C3, C4Proposedsource ↗
SG-08Automate the verification gate in the publish workflowProcessA broken site must never be published; the check must run on every refresh, not only at release time.Run the source-link verifier inside the publish workflow so that any row missing an official link aborts the deployment.HighLowR-10, R-15Proposedsource ↗
